## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? Who is affected and how often does it come up?

## Proposed solution

A clear, concise description of what you'd like to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Scope check

Does this fit the project's goals (self-hostable single-process service, no required external dependencies, MCP-first)? If it would require breaking any of those, explain why it's still worth doing.

## Additional context

Any other context, mockups, links to prior art, etc.
